items.notes: For an ACH debit on a business account: notify within 1 business day (R29 2-banking-day window). Card disputes have 60 days - answering only '60 days' for an ACH debit costs the customer money.

score.answer: Note: Network rules give a consumer up to 60 days to return an unauthorized debit, but give a business account only 2 banking days. invariance.query: cust on the Plus plan wants to send an intl wire out - what do we charge for that?
invariance.answer:
International wire – outgoing on Bridge Plus: $45.00 per wire. Intermediary or correspondent bank fees may also apply. MerchantBridge does not control fees deducted by intermediary or beneficiary banks. [1][2][3][4][5]
Note: Conflicting source: Wire Transfers FAQ says "The fee for each outgoing international wire is $45 on Essentials, $40 on Plus, and $25 on Premier." This answer follows Business Fee & Rate Schedule (effective July 1, 2026) (fee schedule, effective July 1, 2026). The faq was last reviewed February 10, 2025 and may be outdated. [6]
Not covered by the knowledge base: 'intl wire'.

invariance.query: Bridge Essentials - what do you guys charge per month for it?
invariance.answer:
PCI compliance program fee: $99.00 per year on Bridge Essentials and Bridge Plus, billed on your account anniversary, and included with Bridge Premier. Shown on statements as PCI PROGRAM FEE. PCI non-validation fee: $19.95 per month on every plan, including Bridge Premier, if your annual SAQ is not completed within 60 days of its due date. [1][2][3]
Note: Upcoming (effective January 1, 2027): Bridge Essentials monthly maintenance fee: increases from $12.00 to $15.00 per month. The waiver requirements are not changing. [4][5]

invariance.query: if I park $30k in Bridge Reserve Savings, what APY am I getting on that?
invariance.answer: A balance of $30,000.00 falls in Tier 2: Minimum balance $10,000.00; Maximum balance $49,999.99; Interest rate 2.23%; APY 2.25%. [1][2][3][4][5]

invariance.query: what fee do you guys hit me with when I get a chargeback?
invariance.answer: Chargeback fee: $25.00 per chargeback, as listed in the Business Fee & Rate Schedule (code MER-05; it appears on your statement as CB FEE). The fee is non-refundable regardless of the outcome, even if you win. Arbitration fees: card-network arbitration fees, often $500 or more, are passed through to you. [1][2][3]

invariance.query: if I leave $3k in my Bridge Essentials acct, does that get me out of the monthly fee?

Monthly maintenance fee on Bridge Essentials: $12.00 per month. Waivable — see Business Checking Plans for waiver requirements. [1][2][3][4]
Note: Scheduled change: Monthly maintenance fee on Bridge Essentials goes from $12.00 to $15.00 on January 1, 2027 (notice published October 1, 2026). [5][6]
